diagnosis: Survivor is roughly breakeven overall (50.7% win, -$68.37 across 404 trades) but the aggregate masks a clear structural problem: the MOMENTUM strategy (383 trades, 49% win, -$55.81) is the dominant loss driver, while ARB (92% win, +$5.89 on tiny size) is a proven but underused edge. Within momentum, the bot is still entering on weak/moderate moves (10-20bps) that the lesson engine has already validated as a -$33.47 loser across 81 trades, and is holding into low-time-remaining windows (left60-120: -$20.25 over 59 trades; left<60: -$19.40 over 13 trades, both validated/collecting as strong vetoes). Meanwhile strong moves (20+ bps) are solidly profitable (+$10.14, 56% win) and far-from-expiry entries (left120+: +$10.77, 50% win but positive expectancy) work. Coin-level performance confirms a momentum-quality problem, not a universal one: BTC is profitable (+$10.83, 60% win) while DOGE (-$23.45, 39% win) and SOL (-$17.86, 50% win) bleed heavily. The recent decision log shows the lesson-veto system is actively (and correctly) blocking move10-20 setups, but several ENTERs are still slipping through with move magnitudes in the 6-10bps range (sub-threshold moves), which the 'move<10' bucket also shows as a loser (-$5.55, 48% win). The core mis-tuning is that momentum_min_move_bps=22 is not actually being enforced pre-trade consistently — multiple ENTER rows show moves of 6-9.7bps, well under the stated 22bps floor, meaning the hard filter and the lesson veto are catching different things, or the live threshold differs from config. This is the single biggest quant leak.
priorityActions: 1) Audit and fix the discrepancy between configured momentum_min_move_bps=22 and observed live ENTER trades executing at 6-9.7bps moves — this is a filter-enforcement bug, not a tuning issue, and is likely the single largest source of the -$55.81 momentum bleed.

3) Increase min_entry_left_sec to 140 to reduce exposure to the validated-loser left60-120 and left<60 time buckets (combined -$39.65 P&L).
4) Reduce max_trade_pct to 0.02 given thin $33.55 bankroll, CAUTIOUS mode, and 14-trade max loss streak risk — preserve capital while filter fixes take effect.

5) Apply confidence discount concretely to all-agree (4/0 peer) and alone (0 peers) setups rather than just flagging them — e.g., require momentum_min_confidence=0.75 globally as a proxy until per-bucket sizing is available.
